high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "get.waste.ed," which is described as following Russia's state-controlled media. The post features a tweet from El País English Edition (@elpaisinenglish) about an environmental protest. Tweet Content: The tweet mentions that around 70,000 people formed a human chain around Spain's Mar Menor to protest the environmental disaster facing the saltwater lagoon. The protest is described as a "dignified way to say goodbye to so many animals that have died due to human greed."
